description: A real music file format: an MThd header chunk with a fixed length of 6, the file format, the track count, and the time division, followed by that many MTrk chunks, each a big-endian length and that many bytes of delta-timed events. Exercises four-character chunk tags, big-endian lengths, a count in the header that governs the chunk array, and repeated length-prefixed records.

provenance.origin: Short melodies written by corpus/midi/generate.py and read back by an independent chunk and event walker; file identifies each as Standard MIDI data.
provenance.notes: Not derived from any third-party music. Safe to redistribute.
